ownership.panels: The mixed Panels controller remains one shared host for left and right panel mechanics. Document tools keep the existing active-view/floating-editor behavior; no per-tab persistence is added.
ownership.windowsAndTabs: windows/layout/windows.ts keeps the current tabs-containing-views model. The tab strip moves intact with the mixed composer into shell/screen/draw.ts; T36 reviews a cohesive windows/tabs extraction.
ownership.drawing: Document header/content drawing follows documents/views; mixed panel and overlay drawing follows the corresponding shell host. Composer reverse edges are preserved until T9.
